verdict.rationale: Veriff publishes a full public REST API (session creation, decision polling, webhooks, HMAC-signed auth) allowing programmatic driving of the verification flow without SDKs, per [veriff-docs-6][veriff-docs-7][veriff-docs-10][veriff-docs-17]. However, probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (404s) and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of API usage. missing for 10: discoverable OpenAPI/swagger schema, third-party developer confirmation of API integration.
